title: Chaos is feasible
description: 添加了一个让世界扭曲的效果也可能会导致眩晕恶心等Adding an effect that distorts the world may also cause dizziness and nausea.
body:
大家好我是高悲，我添加了一个让世界扭曲的效果也可能会导致眩晕恶心等效果的光影，光照系统则是原版的。正式版1.0.0是在beta0.0.1的基础上让参数更加激进。如果你不想这么激进可以选择beta0.0.1版本
Hello everyone, I am Gao Bei. I have added a lighting effect that distorts the world, which may also cause dizziness and nausea. The lighting system itself remains the original version. This makes the parameters more aggressive compared to beta 0.0.1. If you do not want such intensity, you can choose the beta 0.0.1 version. ...
